annotations.title: Ask to delete this app permanently

description: Asks the founder to permanently delete this project's linked app — this can't be undone. Every record, customer, file, site, domain, relay, AI tool and key goes; every active customer subscription is cancelled in Stripe at once (no refund by Gemmein); the founder's own connected Stripe account is untouched. This is a change to how the business runs: your human approves it in their browser with the emailed code AND by typing the app's exact current name — neither can be skipped from here, and a wrong name refuses before anything is spent. Nothing changes until they approve; approving it carries it out — Gemmein does it the moment they press Approve, once. Returns the approval link for your human; this server has no live_action_status to poll the outcome — check the approval page, or the dashboard's Settings → Connections tab. A second call asks again (a new approval). Use the dashboard (Settings → General) instead if the founder is already there.
